topic:
Recover the ordered rewrite rules a retired address-normalisation engine applied, from about 900 before/after address pairs, as a Python normaliser that reproduces it on unseen addresses.

topic: Recover the ordered rewrite rules a retired address-normalisation engine applied, from about 900
  before/after address pairs, as a Python normaliser that reproduces it on unseen addresses.
shape: rule induction from examples; graded on held-out address pairs
agent_cannot_verify: 'Rule ORDER and rare rules: some rules only fire on combinations seen 2-3 times in
  900 pairs (a unit designator after a PO box, a street type inside a building name), and order changes
  the output only when two rules overlap. Training pairs look solved long before held-out pairs are.'
dial: share of 300 held-out pairs reproduced exactly; fair range 85-97%, start 92%. A rule-per-pattern
  baseline scores about 75%, the oracle 100%.
quirk_matrix:
  rule overlap (order matters):
  - none
  - 2-rule overlap
  - 3-rule chain
  rare rule frequency in training:
  - 5+ instances
  - 2-3 instances
  - 1 instance
  near-miss (must not fire):
  - absent
  - 1 decoy pattern
  - decoy plus casing variant
  mix: about 30% easy cells, the rest medium or hard
self_check_gap: 'every rule is visible many times, so a solution matching all 900 pairs scores ~100% on
  held-out pairs; the only gap is 3-rule chains the training shows pairwise (measured: 4/5 at every setting;
  see CHANGELOG)'
hidden_case_evidence:
- 'every rewrite rule: 2+ pairs'
- 'every pairwise rule overlap: 2+ pairs'
- 'near-miss decoys left unchanged: 2+ pairs'
- 'empty or whitespace-only lines: stated in README (data cannot show)'
answer_source: inferred
reference_access: none
quirk_evidence:

public_tests: 'about 30%: 60 visible pairs in tests_public/ covering single-rule cases; ordering interactions

checks:

- 'ordering: a rule that must run before another (e.g. unit extraction before suffix normalisation)'

- 'output contract: /app/normalise.py reads stdin, one address per line, writes one per line'
knobs:
